question: Should LongCat be accepted as a bundled official provider plugin in OpenClaw, moved to an external official/ClawHub provider package, or left as documented custom-provider configuration?
rationale: The provider SDK can support the requested shape, but root policy keeps core lean and makes new official/bundled provider ownership a maintainer product decision.

options.title: Review bundled provider PR
options.body: Use the linked draft PR as the decision and implementation vehicle, requiring normal provider review plus LongCat live-key proof before landing.

options.title: External provider first
options.body: Keep core lean by asking for an official external provider package discoverable through ClawHub, with bundled promotion only after demand and ownership are clear.

options.title: Keep custom config only
options.body: Do not add an official plugin yet and continue relying on LongCat's manual models.providers setup guide.

recommendation.title: Review bundled provider PR
recommendation.body: Use the linked draft PR as the decision and implementation vehicle, requiring normal provider review plus LongCat live-key proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the issue and linked draft PR and has recent provider-area history.
